moves.name: Reigning Thunder Fang
moves.description: Activation Condition: When a circle is applied to the allied field of play. Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated. Never misses. Lowers the target’s Defense by two stat ranks. Leaves the target paralyzed. Has a chance (50%) of making the target flinch.

moves.name: Max Revive
moves.description: Applies the Endure and Restore effect to an ally.

moves.name: Thunderous Roar Wild Charge
moves.description: Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once. Deactivation Condition: When this move is used. Never misses. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Turns the field of play’s terrain into Electric Terrain. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by two ranks.

moves.name: Thundering Glory!
moves.description: Restores the user’s HP by approximately 20% of its maximum HP. Restores the HP of all allied sync pairs by approximately 30% of their maximum HP. Applies the Gradual Healing effect to all allied sync pairs.

passives.name: Johto’s Thundering Legend
passives.description: Powers up the moves and sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%. Reduces attack move and sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%. The more allied sync pairs with the Johto theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 15% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 50%, and the maximum damage reduction is 31%.) Raises the sync buff of the user’s team by one rank the first time its sync move is used each battle.

subPassives.name: Johto Theme: Move Power ↑ 20%
subPassives.description: Powers up the moves and sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%.

subPassives.name: Johto Theme: Damage Reduction 25%
subPassives.description: Reduces attack move and sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%.

subPassives.name: 1st S-Move: Sync Buff ↑ 1
subPassives.description: Raises the sync buff of the user’s team by 1 rank(s) the first time its sync move is used each battle.

passives.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
passives.description: Grants all of the following effects when the terrain is Electric Terrain: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs. Powers up the sync moves of all allied sync pairs. Reduces attack move damage taken by allies.

passives.name: Rough and Swirling Electric Energy
passives.description: Raises the Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, and Sp. Def of all allied sync pairs by two stat ranks when the user’s attack move is successful.

passives.name: Debut / 1st S-Move: Johto C (Phys & Spec) on Field
passives.description: Applies Johto Circle (Physical) and Johto Circle (Special) to the allied field of play the first time the user enters a battle each battle. Applies Johto Circle (Physical) and Johto Circle (Special) to the allied field of play the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle.

cells.title: Johto C (Phys & Spec) Extension 5
cells.description: Extends the duration of Johto Circle (Physical) when Johto Circle (Physical) is applied to the allied field of play. Extends the duration of Johto Circle (Special) when Johto Circle (Special) is applied to the allied field of play.

cells.title: 1st S-Move: Restore B-Move MP 1
cells.description: Restores one MP of the user’s buddy move the first time its sync move is used each battle.

cells.title: Hit: Team Defense ↑ & Sp. Def ↑ 9
cells.description: Raises the Defense and Sp. Def of all allied sync pairs by one stat rank when the user’s attack move is successful.

cells.title: Natural Remedy
cells.description: Removes all status conditions from the user the first time it is inflicted by any status condition each battle.

cells.title: Head Start 2
cells.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by two the first time it enters a battle each battle.

cells.title: Shock Recovery 1
cells.description: Restores the user’s HP whenever its Pokémon takes an action when the terrain is Electric Terrain.

cells.title: Turbo Charge 2
cells.description: Quickly charges the move gauge when the terrain is Electric Terrain.

cells.title: Hit: Team Attack ↑ & Sp. Atk ↑ 9
cells.description: Raises the Attack and Sp. Atk of all allied sync pairs by one stat rank when the user’s attack move is successful.

cells.title: Electric Terrain: Team Condition Nullification
cells.description: Prevents all allied sync pairs from being inflicted with status conditions, flinching, becoming confused, or becoming trapped when the terrain is Electric Terrain.

cells.title: Thunderous Roar Wild Charge: Move Gauge Refresh 3
Quick Cure
cells.description: Removes the confused, flinching, and trapped conditions from the user the first time they are inflicted each battle.

cells.title: T-Move: Team Physical Boost ↑1 9
cells.description: Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by one rank when the user’s Trainer uses a move.

cells.title: Vigilance
cells.description: Protects the user against critical hits.

cells.title: Reigning Thunder Fang: Move Gauge Refresh 3
Team Sharp Entry 3
cells.description: Raises the critical-hit rate of all allied sync pairs by three stat ranks when the user enters a battle.

cells.title: 1st S-Move: Team Physical Boost 2
cells.description: Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by two ranks the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle.
